name: maintainer-component-review
description: Focused read-only review of one Clibridge component, producing a small improvement plan for the next gated change.

inputDefaults.paths: Inspect the component's source, tests, docs, and direct consumers.
inputDefaults.focus: correctness, security, operability, test coverage, and maintainability

assertions.message: The focused component review is read-only; use a separate gated implementation workflow for changes.

phases.name: review
improvement-plan

mockData.stopReason: Dry-run fixture only; run the review against the checkout before deciding.
